content: Yeesu a yi uup yak Musaa
Weɗ tah ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɗu hoolɗuuɗ wuu Kooh te ɓoo ɓaah ŋ ɓeeɗkohiŋ Eel ci. Kon, markaat ŋ Yeesu, yi nik Woosuuɗi, a nikka Seeƴkiɗohi yakki ŋ waasi ɓoo na woye ne weɗ ɓoo kos.
A tokɗukeen baahiɗ ŋ pangki Kooh degee ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe, findi Musaa namee « tokɗukoh ŋ ɗooƴ kahan Kooh [jen] », findi Fiis ci woyoha.
Yi taɓah kahni a yi uup kahni. Weɗ tah, Yeesu eɗaah cir na kiyak ki uup wiŋ Musaa.
Kahan nu taɓahu ɗah, a ɓo' taɓaha waaye a Kooh taɓah in ci jen.
Mbaa, Musaa « tokɗukeen ŋ ɗooƴ kahan Kooh jen. » Ŋ woo kiŋ Fiis ci weem, a tokɗukee findi yi na pangkiɗe Yi raak kahni, ne a seede ini Kooh hee woye.
Kiristaa nak, a tokɗukiɗ findi kuɓu ne a adgoh kahan Kooh, te e ɓoo kahneem nik ne ɓoo gen ooluk, wa hun na kaañ, te ɓoo ndamkohe yaakaari ɓoo yaakaar ɗah.
Weɗi tah, findi Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woyoha, ngaŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci, an :

content.text: te raak ɓa hotee ngaŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo
ɓa inhanɗi ini maa seke ne ɓa tuma. ”
“ Ɓa rahsanɗi muk iɗsiɗki ŋ gap ɓa. ” »

content: Kon ɓaah ciŋ ngo wortukaat po ali ɓo' nga ɗu raakuu keeñ baahaaɗi, wi na koseeɗi po wa kee ɗe ɓeka ŋ eɗ finho Koohi na pese.
Waaye feeh "woti", wi Fiis ci na woye, wa ɗii nga ɗah, genaat ñaahtiɗoh Kooh-nu-wiis, ne bakaaɗ ñaañohuu ali ɓo' nga ɗu po wa kee ɗe ɓeka keeñ ndengiɗ.
Laam, ɓoo ɓaahiɗ na Mucɗohi Gapohse pangki, nik ne ɓoo risiɗ amb ndengiɗ po ŋ reehtinohaana, oolki ɓoo oolkee ngaŋ camba ɗah.
Mbaa e ɓinde kerhee hoosooriŋ Kooh, ɓa ndengsiɗkoheeɗa na ɗe ? Wa hooliɗ ne e ɓooɓa Musaa pulɗohee Misra jen.
Kooh namee raak neɓsaaɗi ŋ ɓinde ini ree kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis (40) ? Wa hooliɗ ne e ɓooɓa bakaaɗee te fiɗaaf caŋ ɓa keennda ŋ kehƴa hulanga.
Te Kooh giñee ne e ɓinde heyɗi rahse iɗsiɗka a gapee ɓa ? Wa hooliɗ ne e ɓooɓa kerhiɗeeɗi ɗe.
Mbaa ɓoo hotiɗ ne ɓa mineeɗi aas sagu kosaaɗi.
